blurb: Guests sail on the m/s Paul Gauguin, an intimate luxury cruise ship exploring pristine lagoons in French Polynesia and the South Pacific. The ship features oceanview accommodations, gourmet dining, a spa, fitness center, boutique, and live local entertainment. Activities include kayaking, paddle boarding, PADI SCUBA diving, and exclusive visits to private islands Motu Mahana and a beach retreat in Bora Bora.
